# load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(janitor)
```

#load spending data
```{r}

spending <- read_csv("../data/federal_spending_by_county_2020 2024 rob_0416_v2.csv") |> 
     clean_names()

```

# pokin around
```{r}

spending |> 
group_by(agency) |> 
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    total_spent = sum(spending_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(total_spent))

```
